_note: One forfeit per player, played straight after their Hat A reveal. Keyed by player name — a player not in the draw is skipped, and a player with no entry here just moves on. `clubs` lists every club the question depends on; if the player no longer holds all of them the forfeit is dropped at bake time, so a redraw can never leave a question about somebody else's team on the screen. `timer` puts a countdown on the prompt. `crest` blurs a club badge onto the prompt screen. `quote` is read aloud rather than answered. `blur` blurs the prompt and the club-name line itself, for anything (a spelling test, say) that would otherwise be given away by its own text being on screen. `points` is what it's nominally worth if they pass it — the host reviews and can adjust every value at the end of the night before anything is published, so this is a starting point, not a ruling.
